purpose: Independently test whether residual guitar errors are dominated by missing/unsynchronized reference events rather than wrong pitch among onset-matched events.

dataset.name: GuitarSet
dataset.holdoutStatus: fresh-before-this-diagnostic; consumed after first reference score

scoring.primaryPairing: maximum-cardinality onset-only, then minimum total absolute onset error; pitch never selects primary pairs
scoring.replicationGate: unmatchedReferenceCount > assignmentDependentWrongPitchCount pooled AND separately for each player 00/01/03
scoring.gatePurpose: test direction of the missing/unsynchronized-event hypothesis only; not an admission or production gate

stopConditions: Do not change thresholds or predictions from this result.
Do not treat players 00/01/03 as fresh after first score.
Do not touch Go My Way candidate, main, Production, bass, separator, or timing baselines.
If the replication gate fails, stop and record the contradiction.
If it passes, record one independently supported hypothesis only; implementation still requires a separately frozen experiment.
